summary: No high-severity findings; project id cannot escape registryDir/projects (randomUUID, re-forced on update), symlink guards effective for pastes, middleware mounted before all repo-writing routes, bloat ceilings not grown.

review.finding: Invariant meta-test is line-based; a multi-line join(...) with the literal on its own line evades it.
Actions cache is keyed by projectPath while the user file now depends on dataDir; a flag flip or two projects at one path can share a stale entry.
SHIPWRIGHT_DATA_DIR is used verbatim; a relative value resolves against the cwd at each use.
project.id is joined into a path with no format check (defence in depth; ids are UUIDs today).
The step comment above the run_config write was deleted to hold the bloat ceiling; restore a one-line comment.
Unrelated comments were condensed in terminal/routes.ts and image-paste.ts only to hold ceilings; revert where headroom allows.
No tests for PATCH standalone type validation, updateAutonomy skipping the run_config write, or middleware ordering in index.ts.
Pasted-image paths for a standalone project point outside the repo cwd; document the caveat.
